title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Anthropic's founders rang the Nasdaq opening bell on Thu 19 Nov. NBC News reports the shares became eligible to trade at 10:00 ET with market makers pointing to an open near $99.60, Yahoo Finance cites early indications up to $103 against the $83 IPO price, and the first trade and first-day close had not been reported at last check.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
next_label: First trade and first-day close as ANT
sources: Anthropic, NBC News, Yahoo Finance, CNBC, CNN, Forbes, Bloomberg

title: Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, Kress named interim
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: CNBC reports interim CEO Colette Kress told staff at the first all-hands on Wed 18 Nov to move forward, and Quartz reports the shares fell about 2% that day; Crypto Briefing reports Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella publicly backed Kress at the DealBook Summit. Fox Business reports chair Harvey Jones said the board will look at internal and external candidates and is in no rush, so there is no timetable for a permanent CEO.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
sources: Nvidia, CNBC, Quartz, Fox Business, Bloomberg, Crypto Briefing

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: CBS News reports Iran said on Thu 19 Nov that two more tankers hit mines in Hormuz, after UKMTO confirmed a tanker was hit by a projectile off Khasab on Wed, and Gulf News and Business Recorder report Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh. Gulf News reports Trump is weighing new strikes on Iran; the US blockade is still in place, Bloomberg reports one of three carriers has left the region, and no ceasefire has been reported.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: CBS News, Gulf News, Business Recorder, Bloomberg, NBC News, CoinDesk

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: Yahoo Finance reports Strategy turned higher overnight after falling more than 6% on Wed 18 Nov, and Nexo and Cryptonomist report bitcoin climbed back toward $64,000 on Thu after dipping close to $62,000 overnight. Nexo, citing SoSoValue, reports $306M of net outflows from US spot bitcoin ETFs on Wed; the MSCI deletion takes effect after the close on 30 Nov, and it is still open whether other index providers will follow.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga, Nexo, Cryptonomist, The Crypto Times
